input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is only a successors-and-assigns/no-third-party-beneficiary provision; it contains no assignment mechanics at all. The good news is there is no prohibition on our assignment and no change-of-control trigger anywhere in the document (searches for "change of control" return nothing, and the only termination rights are the mutual 90-day convenience right in Section 8/p0024 and our 70-day right in p0011), so the walk-away items are absent. However, the clause also imposes no control over HDI: it leaves HDI free to assign the site development and hosting relationship to any transferee, including a competitor of the Company, with no notice and no consent. That fails the fallback, which requires consent for non-successor assignments not to be unreasonably withheld. We therefore propose the minimal insertion reaching the preferred position: an express affiliate/successor carve-out for us, confirmation that our change of control gives HDI no termination or re-pricing right, and a consent-plus-no-competitor gate on HDI's assignment. The fallback (mutual assignment to successors on written notice with a reasonable-consent standard for other transfers) is offered in the comment.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent to any of its affiliates or to any successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or business, and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added our standard assignment provision: we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger or sale of assets without consent and without giving HDI any termination or re-pricing right, while HDI's assignment requires our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and may never be to a competitor. As drafted, Section 10.3 only binds successors and assigns and leaves HDI free to transfer our site development and hosting relationship to anyone, including a competitor; if helpful we can instead accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.
proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment right for the Company, no HDI right on our change of control, and a consent/no-competitor gate on HDI assignment.
